#
 Spiritual
 Translation


---


**
¶4.
** The first
 great
 epoch
 is the
 Divine
 Wisdom itself
.
 From
 the time when the
 Celestial Mind descended into the deep
est states
 of falsity and was
 overwhelmed by them
 —
 and
 Divine
 Truth proce
eding from the Lord
 was
 sent forth
,
 which
 went
 down
 and
 raised
 it
 up.
 After the Celest
ial Mind had been
 lifted
 out
 of those
 depths
, the Divine Love and the
 Divine
 Proce
eding established all
 things in order
:
 the interior
 states
 of heaven
 and the exterior
 states of the natural mind alike
.

**¶5.**
 Furthermore
, the Divine
 Love
 made itself manifest and
 dwelt within the doctrine of wisdom
. It
 revealed
 its own
 divine
-
human form, and
 it separated
 and
 purified whatever
 of
 truth
 and
 wisdom
 had been com
mingled with all
 things
 false
. It governed
 from the highest celestial states.
 Until
 the time when every
 external
 form
 of
 the
 church
 shall
 be dissolved, all appearances
 of truth
 consumed
, the
 in
most love
 of
 the Divine released
 as
 a
 final
 judgment,
 and the completed Divine
-Human
 Form
 —
 the universal heav
enly person
 composed
 of all
 who
 have received
 life
 — shall ascend into its
 fullness.
 These three works
 of redemption were begun in
 the first epoch,
 when the Celestial Mind was sent
 forth together
 with its five fac
ulties of spiritual perception.

**
¶6.** In
 contrast, the first spiritual
 death is the falsity and
 evil that com
mingled with those
 five faculties of perception
 belonging
 to the Celestial Mind,
 corru
pting them
 from
 within.

**¶7.
** The second great
 epoch is the state
 when those
 celest
ial goods and truths that prevailed
 through spiritual combat take
 up
 governance in the new state of heaven
 and
 d
well in the regener
ated
 natural mind. They reign in
 this
 new heav
enly state until the Divine unveils its
 essential and
 in
most form above them.

**
¶8.** The duration of their
 dwelling
 in the peace
 of
 this
 new state corresponds
 exactly
 to the measure of the prior epoch spent
 in spiritual tem
ptation and affl
iction.
 They shall reign in
 this manner
 and experience
 the
 joy of the new heav
enly state for
 an
 equal
 measure
.


**¶9.** The
 great third epoch is the
 state
 when the Divine unve
ils its inmost form over
 them, and
 raises them into itself,
 and
 receives them into the inmost heaven —
 the
 hidden
 treasury of the Divine — and gives
 to
 each
 what
 belongs
 to its
 very
 life
. The
 Divine can pour out upon them the
 celest
ial delight of
 its
 love
 and
 the sweetness of its presence
, which takes
 away every
 memory of affl
iction they
 have known
 through
 all
 their perception
. There
 is fullness and joy
 without
 end. When the Divine Grace
 has
 wholly
 satisfied them, it
 gives to
 them its
 own quality
,
 and they are made utt
erly new within
 themselves
.

**¶10.**
 Also
, the
 Divine can summon them once more into
 a
 state of celest
ial peace and interior
 silence, and bring
 their
 spiritual form
 to the same complet
eness and
 st
ature as the first and
 highest
 heav
ens. And it
 establ
ishes each faculty and
 power
 in its proper heav
enly state
, in
 the
 dwelling
 that
 corresponds to its quality. They shall d
well in the new heaven
,
 each
 within
 the
 state
 that
 is truly
 their own.

**¶11
.** Now, when they dwell
 each
 within
 their proper
 state
, they become infinitely enriched,
 beyond all measure
, beyond
 all time. From that
 point
 forward they
 do
 not rec
kon successive
 states
 among
 themselves —
 neither
 periods
,
 nor degrees
, nor progress
ions,
 from
 one
 et
ernity to the
 next. The Divine is no longer hidden
 from them, from this time on
ward. Rather, the
 Divine has accomplished its full
 self
-revelation to them,
 and
 remains
 perpet
ually manifest
 before
 them forever
.

**¶12.**
 These are the three great epochs of
 spiritual
 history
,
 which
 the Divine from
 its
 own infinite
 wisdom has numbered
 and
 ordered
.

**¶13.**
 In contrast, the two spiritual
 deaths that have
 been disclosed
 are
 these:


**¶14.** The
 first death extends
 from the time when wisdom and
 truth
 first
 fell into falsity and
 became
 com
mingled with the
 ruling
 ev
ils of
 the
 h
ells —
 until the time when all
 truth
 shall be purified and wholly
 separated from fals
ity in the final judgment of
 divine
 love. Whatever
 of
 good
 remains
 after
 that
 separation
 builds toward and
 compl
etes that
 ultimate
 Divine
-Human Form.

**¶
15.** Now
, the second death is the death in
 which the interiors of those given
 over to evil shall per
ish.
 They
 are stripped
 of the remaining
 illumin
ation of
 wisdom that had given
 light
 to their understanding.
 They are cut
 off from the living influx of the
 Divine
 through
 which they had
 received the very
 capacity for
 spiritual
 thought.
 They are deprived of the living
 soul —
 the
 interior
 recept
acle of life
 that
 had sustained
 them
 in
 the world.
 They are sev
ered utt
erly from the completed Divine-Human Form
 and
 are
 bound fast
 within
 their own
 evils. Their corrupted will —
 the perv
erted affection
 that
 once
 might
 have received
 good
 — becomes the
 very
 substance
 of their torment and
 their
 affliction,
 according
 to their
 works
,
 cons
igned
 to those
 three
 inf
ernal states
.

**¶16.**
 These are the two deaths. The first
 death is temporal —
 it
 belongs
 to the age
 of redem
ption and
 has
 an
 end. But
 the second death is eternal. *
It is the second death.*

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The first day is our father, the Man. From the time when the First Man went down to the abyss of darkness and drowned in it; and the Living Spirit was sent, who went and bore him up. After the Man had ascended, the Father of Life and the Great Spirit set things in order, and the worlds above and below.

Furthermore, the glorious Ambassador came and dwelt in the ship of the day. He displayed his glorious image, and he purified the light out of all things. He walked in the heights of the heavens. Till the time when the world will be dissolved, all things destroyed, the great fire released, and the Last Statue ascends. These three deeds were begun on this first day, when they sent the First Man with his five sons.
In contrast, [the first death] is the darkness that mixed with the five sons of the First Man.

The second day is the time when the fathers of light, who were victorious in the struggle, will sit on their thrones in the new aeon and dwell on the new earth. And they reign in the new aeon till the Father unveils his image above them.
The {length of the sojourn} in the new aeon equals the measure of the first day spent in affliction. They will reign like this and rejoice in the new aeon.

The great third day [is the time] when the Father will unveil over them his image [in its fullness] [and his glory;] and he raises them up [to himself,] and he receives them into his hidden treasury [of life,] and he gives [to each one] his soul. He can pour out upon them [the delight of his love,] his ambrosia and his sweet perfume, which takes away all affliction that they have seen with their eyes. [It is a] fullness and a joy eternal! When his grace would sate them, he gives to them his [own likeness,] and they are made anew in them.

Also, he can summon them once more in peace and silence, and perfect their stature in same measure as his first aeons. And he sets each power in its aeon, in its dwelling-place. They will dwell in the new aeon in their aeons!

Now, when they dwell in their aeons, they will become rich beyond measure, for ever, beyond time. From then on they will not count that season amongst them; nor the number of the days, nor the hours, generation after generation, for ever and ever. The Father will not be hidden from them, from this time on. Rather, he has accomplished (his) unveiling to them [in its fullness,] he being revealed to them for ever.
These are the three great days, [which the Father of Greatness has numbered and set in order from his wisdom].
In contrast, the two deaths that I have proclaimed to you are these.

The first death is from the time when the light fell to the darkness, and was mixed in with the rulers of darkness; until the time when the light will become pure, and be separated from the darkness in that great fire. The remainder left behind there can build and add to that Last Statue.

Now, the second death is the death in which the souls of sinful men shall die; when [they will] be stripped of the shining light that illuminates the world. And also they are separated from the living air, from which they receive [living] breath; and they are deprived of this living soul, which [sustains them] in the world; and they are separated and swept away from this Last Statue [that gathers the light at the end. They are cast down into the abyss] and bound on [to the darkness, within their own evils;] the female will become [the very source of] their torture and their affliction; for their deeds [shall consign them to] those three places;
These are the two deaths. The first death is temporal; [but] the second death is eternal. It is the sec[ond deat]h!
